plugins.name: semantic-memory
plugins.description: Unified memory-layer plugin for Claude Code. One MCP server, 40 tools across multi-corpus search/read/write/graph/lint/sessions/contract. v1.1.0 adds: AGENTS.md contract artifact, hard-gated verification sessions (session_start/run/finish/status), proposal-mode synthesize_note + synthesize_promote, multi-agent skill bundler (codex/copilot/pi via the new `skills` CLI), and SessionStart drift detection. Backwards-compatible with v1.0.x — every previous tool name remains callable through deprecation shims (removed in v2.0.0).
